∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Ring.{u_1} A] {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype.{u_2} ι] {V : ι → Type u_3}
  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → AddCommGroup.{u_3} (V i)] [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Module.{u_1, u_3} A (V i)]
  [∀ (i : ι), IsSimpleModule.{u_1, u_3} A (V i)] (n : ι → Nat),
  (∀ ⦃i j : ι⦄,
      Nonempty.{u_3 + 1} (LinearEquiv.{u_1, u_1, u_3, u_3} (RingHom.id.{u_1} A) (V i) (V j)) → Eq.{u_2 + 1} i j) →
    ∀ (W : Submodule.{u_1, max u_3 u_2} A (DirectSum.{u_2, u_3} ι fun i => Fin (n i) → V i)),
      Exists.{u_2 + 1} fun r =>
        And (∀ (i : ι), LE.le.{0} (r i) (n i))
          (Nonempty.{max ((max u_3 u_2) + 1) ((max u_2 u_3) + 1)}
            (LinearEquiv.{u_1, u_1, max u_2 u_3, max u_3 u_2} (RingHom.id.{u_1} A)
              (Subtype.{(max u_2 u_3) + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{max u_2 u_3, max u_2 u_3} W x)
              (DirectSum.{u_2, u_3} ι fun i => Fin (r i) → V i)))

∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Ring.{u_1} A] {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype.{u_2} ι] {V : ι → Type u_3}
  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → AddCommGroup.{u_3} (V i)] [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Module.{u_1, u_3} A (V i)]
  [∀ (i : ι), IsSimpleModule.{u_1, u_3} A (V i)] (n : ι → Nat),
  (∀ ⦃i j : ι⦄,
      Nonempty.{u_3 + 1} (LinearEquiv.{u_1, u_1, u_3, u_3} (RingHom.id.{u_1} A) (V i) (V j)) → Eq.{u_2 + 1} i j) →
    ∀ (W : Submodule.{u_1, max u_2 u_3} A ((i : ι) → Fin (n i) → V i)),
      Exists.{u_2 + 1} fun r =>
        And (∀ (i : ι), LE.le.{0} (r i) (n i))
          (Nonempty.{(max u_2 u_3) + 1}
            (LinearEquiv.{u_1, u_1, max u_2 u_3, max u_2 u_3} (RingHom.id.{u_1} A)
              (Subtype.{(max u_2 u_3) + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{max u_2 u_3, max u_2 u_3} W x)
              ((i : ι) → Fin (r i) → V i)))

rule: Use primary exactly when the declaration itself states or defines the source claim. Use supporting for prerequisites, constructions, helper lemmas, instances, or consequences that help formalize the item but do not themselves state it.
source_text: If W ≤ ⨁_i n_i V_i for finitely many finite-dimensional pairwise nonisomorphic irreducibles V_i, then W ≅ ⨁_i r_i V_i for multiplicities r_i ≤ n_i.
